1.web: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
1.asv: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.

2.web: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?
2.asv: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?

3.web: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.
3.asv: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

4.web: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
4.asv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

5.web: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
5.asv: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.

6.web: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was inflicted by the many;
6.asv: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was inflicted by the many;

7.web: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
7.asv: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.

8.web: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
8.asv: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm your love toward him.

9.web: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
9.asv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.

10.web: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
10.asv: But to whom ye forgive anything, I forgive also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes have I forgiven it in the presence of Christ;

11.web: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
11.asv: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

12.web: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
12.asv: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,

13.web: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
13.asv: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.

14.web: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
14.asv: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.

15.web: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;
15.asv: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;

16.web: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
16.asv: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

17.web: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
17.asv: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.
